project_name: Match the reference image painting and material finish: premium hand-painted fantasy RPG art, generous sculpted forms, warm aged bronze, dark petrol stone, restrained turquoise, amber highlights from upper left, soft colored outlines and graduated shadows. Greek mythic underworld Catabase. Strong readable silhouettes and calm broad forms. No modern objects, no text, no lettering, no digits, no labels, no watermark. Create one production atlas of EXACTLY 6 separate icons in a regular 3 columns by 2 rows grid. Read order is left to right, then top to bottom. Each object fills about 68 percent of its cell, centered, equally scaled, generous empty margins, no overlap between cells. Three-quarter object view, front-readable glyphs where appropriate. Every pixel of the empty background must be uniform midnight blue #141D2E. No paper, no scene, no background texture or cast shadows beyond each object. No visible grid lines or frames around atlas cells. DO NOT repeat the reference objects; paint the requested new subjects. Exact contents: cell 1: a hefty Myrmidon bronze spear with hooked levering tip and leather grip; cell 2: a short sacrificial bronze dagger with ruby edge fissure and dark red wrapped grip; cell 3: an elegant long bronze throwing javelin with ivory fletching and a focused teal sight gem; cell 4: a graceful short Greek xiphos sword with leaf-shaped blade and teal cloth grip; cell 5: a heavy square-headed ancient bronze war mace with thick geometric flanges; cell 6: a forged dark bronze spearhead with orange-hot rune-free furnace core.
